Epic: bd-01M1Z987V50254M59P9MNGP9FH
Delivery phase: 1 of 6; child 3 of 12.
Design: docs/design/interaction.md; full snapshot retained in the epic note.
Status: planned work; no implementation or passing evidence is asserted.

Scope
Derive picking geometry from the resolved device scene, preserving clips, transforms, panels, draw order, and batch indices. Define direct/nearest queries and area predicates for each built-in primitive. Share semantics between SVG and Canvas.

Acceptance criteria
1. Hit queries agree with an independent exhaustive oracle on coincident points, strokes, polygons, boundaries, clipped marks, rotations, composition, and point batches.
2. Distance tolerances are in display pixels; CSS size and device scale are applied exactly once.
3. Fill/stroke picking, transparent-target policy, nearest cutoff, overlap ties, and text/image bounds are explicit and tested.
4. Rectangle/lasso predicates distinguish center-inside, fully-contained, and intersecting geometry, including boundary inclusion.
5. Extension primitives declare picking capability or report an explicit unsupported capability; DOM targeting cannot silently change semantic results.

Exclusions
No universal pixel-alpha picking or performance capacity claim; accelerated indexing is addressed by the scale task.

Required evidence
Deterministic geometry fixtures and oracle comparisons on JVM/Scala.js; targeted browser coordinate-mapping checks when the widget is available.
Retain tested source SHA, fixture inputs, expected outputs, and actual gate results. Pending or unavailable checks remain explicitly pending.

Prerequisites
bd-01M1Z9B131PK2DW4D6004XQ5Q4

Coordination
Reserve only actual files when implementation starts. Parent containment is not a prerequisite on the epic; do not create a child-to-epic dependency cycle.
set.title: [Intaglio][Interaction 03] Implement renderer-neutral picking with independent geometry oracles
